description: Provision a persistent API key with no human, browser, or email in the loop. Call this once, store the returned `secret` (shown only this one time), and use it as the Authorization header on every later call: create_proof, list_proofs, revoke_proof, get_balance, buy_stamps (verify_proof needs no auth). The key owns its own creator id, with no identity attached. Free stamps: one per network, so check `freeStamp` in the result; when it is false, the key needs prepaid stamps (buy_stamps) or x402 payment before its first stamp. Rate-limited to 3 keys per network per day; for 3 free stamps a month or a human-owned account, direct a person to makemark.io/account instead.

label.description: Optional label to recognize this key later, e.g. the agent or project name

name: create_account
